mitigationPrecision.position: Supported for the inspected source path: default XML_ENTITIES contains the five predefined names; SAX handles numeric references and reports unknown entities; the inspected DTD handler builds metadata rather than fetching an external subset. No external-entity I/O resolver was identified here. Mammoth records a diagnostic then throws after parseFromString returns (xmldom.js5-19); reader.js15-19 rejects that error. Say reported diagnostics cause rejection, not that every malformed/hostile document has been proven detected or that rejection necessarily stops parser work immediately. This is not a new XXE finding or deployed-parser proof.

The inspected body-reader constructs image read callbacks; documents.Image stores callable reader methods; raw-text.js walks children/text/tabs and does not invoke those image read methods. This supports the ordinary raw-text image-laziness observation without claiming every archive entry inflates eagerly or attesting deployed bundle behavior.

Current-controller and aborted checks guard text/error writes; busy cleanup is owner-checked. App.tsx335 conditionally mounts ProfileDialog, supporting unmount on close and its abort cleanup. Extracted text is a React text value; applying a profile stores derived fields only when remember is chosen. Prefer no raw-resume upload/storage sink identified in the reviewed path over universal no-network/never-in-memory claims. Closing UI is not proof that outstanding buffers/work have been erased; derived profile fields may intentionally persist.
